title: Establishment of District Consumer Protection Council

content.scenario: The State Government of Tamil Nadu wants to establish a consumer protection council in each district of the state. It must establish a District Consumer Protection Council in each district by notification, with effect from a specified date.
content.outcome: The State Government of Tamil Nadu will establish a District Consumer Protection Council in each district by notification, with effect from a specified date, as required by law. This notification will specify the date from which the District Council will be established.

user_queries: What is the procedure for establishing a District Consumer Protection Council?
How does the State Government notify the establishment of a District Council?
What is the role of the District Council in consumer protection?
